entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: An information element that contains the service-level authentication and authorization response from the DN when the procedure completes unsuccessfully with cause #29.

entities.name: Service-level authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: A procedure for authenticating and authorizing the user at the service level, which may complete unsuccessfully.

entities.name: Service-level AA procedure completed unsuccessfully with cause #29
entities.description: The condition where the service-level authentication and authorization procedure fails with 5GSM cause #29 'user authentication or authorization failed'.

entities.name: Network includes Service-level-AA container IE
entities.description: The network includes the Service-level-AA container IE when the service-level AA procedure fails with cause #29 and the DN provides a service-level-AA response.

relations.description: The network includes the Service-level-AA container IE only if the service-level AA procedure completed unsuccessfully with cause #29.
The network includes the Service-level-AA container IE when the condition is met.
The condition is defined by the outcome of the service-level authentication and authorization procedure.
